reviews.text: AWESOME game, played the DEMO for 10 hours (and it was just the first map). Gameplay loop is addicting and doesn't tire you. Looking forward to playing this game in full now and try it with the boyz!!

[h1]当一个光荣的24小时不休息的守卫战士！[/h1] 《Defender Bros》是由Lucky Dart研发的一款俯视角策略塔防动作射击游戏，游戏里我们需要操纵一名战士日以继夜的守护基地，日间出外搜寻空降包获取零件资源，顺便还需要消灭野外的那些大昆虫，夜晚的时候大昆虫会从四周的巢穴向基地杀来，我们需要在这之前使用零件资源在他们的必经之道上构筑防御塔、陷阱、路障等防御，抵御到每一个天明就算一天胜利，周而复始！ 游戏的防御塔种类不多，除了局外可以利用每次战败结算后获取的金币进行科技树升级之外，在战斗过程中角色升级的时候也有几率可以选择到防御塔属性提升，在零件资源足够的时候也可以是用零件来提升等级，养成元素算是比较充足，就是稍微繁琐了一点，需要自己跑过去一个个升级，要是可以转化到大地图直接一个个点击升级就好了！这点在局外科技树的时候也是，局外科技树升级没有列表，需要我们按左右按键一个一个的挑选，这个过程不够人性化，毕竟那么多的建筑和属性，还有狗和背包，这么多都要一个个按过去，太繁琐了！ 不过目前游戏的平衡性还是差了点，基本只需要在局外花几百块金币把初级防御塔点上几级（攻击力直接从几十跳到几百，差距拉得有点大！），然后局内角色升级的时候优先选择“杀怪获得资源”、“增加小狗”、“无敌金身”、“子弹穿透”，然后在四条路径上随便扔一个旋转陷阱，四五个防御塔，一俩个路障，就基本站着通关都行了。问题主要出在防御塔升级数据提升太大上，应该还是比较好解决的吧！ 整体而言，《Defender Bros》还算是过得去的，喜欢这种题材的小伙伴很容易被吸引，不断防守的感觉真是太爽了！而且游戏还支持多人在线联机，就是这一起联机的小伙伴不大好找哇！好在目前的版本单人也能很好的游玩，就希望制作组把数值平衡一下，再把成就系统放出来，那就完美了！ [quote]关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/36224058/]老实人鉴赏家 [/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/laoshirenLSR]老实人评测[/url]：独立游戏爱好者聚集地，黄油绅士交流中心。 不错过游戏的亮点，不放过游戏的槽点，带给玩家最直观的测评感受。[/quote]

The strategic depth is exceptional, allowing for numerous ways to reinforce your base and optimize defenses. The cooperative gameplay fosters teamwork, making every victory even more satisfying. One highly recommended addition to the game would be the inclusion of grenades. These would provide an exciting dynamic in combat, offering players the ability to clear large groups of enemies. This small enhancement could add a whole new layer of strategy and fun to an already amazing game!

good game, been playing it with my little bro. feels like something from 2012, but I mean that as a compliment. it's simple and fun.

Load it up and start shooting, the load times are minimal and the action is maximal at least early on. Great game and foundation to build on. I'd like to see improved towers, talent tree after reaching level 100 or infinite level scaling just to see how crazy it can get. Note: It is about 20 hours of game play give or take with its current state. And its multiplayer so play with your mates or solo.
It's good, and worth the asking price. -Early Access, but manageable. -Scratches that arcade like itch. -Developers are responsive. --- -Highly recommend.

Love the game, it's like a mix of tower defense and a top down shooter with some roguelike elements. Like: easy to get into and feel strong enough to compete solo and complete levels. Dislike: Towers seem underwhelming at first but get better after you "upgrade" them. Saw some activity in the forums, hoping they're still working on the game, maybe hold off to see what happens.
喜加一默认好评系列 游戏真好玩，容易上瘾，一次性玩了八个小时。
Fun game, but need more content

Not bad. Fun for a short while, but the maps are just different cups of the same tea. You take control of a soldier. During the day, you can explore around your base and collect crates and fight mobs. And go back to your base and build your defenses. When it turns night, the waves start coming.
It’s stupid. It’s janky. It’s missing content. But for a few hours, erasing waves of enemies with a weaponized zoo is peak entertainment.

[h1]Defender Bros[/h1] [b]Rating:[/b] 2/10 — Starts Strong, Falls Apart Fast [h1]The Short Version[/h1] [b]Verdict:[/b] I had a blast for the first 7 hours, but the deeper you get, the worse it becomes. What starts as a fun tower defense quickly reveals itself to be an unpolished experience where the developers seemingly ran out of ideas. [table] [tr] [th]Category[/th] [th]Rating[/th] [/tr] [tr] [td]Initial Fun[/td] [td]High (First few hours)[/td] [/tr] [tr] [td]Balance[/td] [td]Broken / Non-existent[/td] [/tr] [tr] [td]Polished[/td] [td]Buggy & Glitchy[/td] [/tr] [/table] [hr][/hr] [h1]Gameplay & Balancing Issues[/h1] [i]"Newer isn't always better, but here, it makes everything else obsolete."[/i] [b]Zero Tower Balance:[/b] Progression feels pointless because there is no strategy in tower choice. As soon as you unlock a new tower, the previous ones become completely obsolete. [list] [*] Once you get the [b]Flamethrower[/b] or the [b]Energy Tower[/b], there is zero reason to use anything else. [*] Walls and other defenses are effectively useless, making the "strategy" element disappear. [/list] [b]Useless Upgrades & False Marketing:[/b] The game claims to have "unlimited upgrades," but that is simply not true. [list] [*] [b]The Hard Cap:[/b] You can max out an item with 2 million gold; there is a very definite ceiling. [*] [b]Conflicting Mechanics:[/b] Many upgrades negate each other. For example, upgrading stamina is pointless because the hoverboard provides infinite stamina anyway. [*] [b]Broken Gear:[/b] Pets, backpacks, and Mechs are all poorly implemented and offer almost no real help. [/list] [h1]Technical State[/h1] [b]Bugs & Glitches:[/b] The game feels like an unpolished asset flip in its current state. [list] [*] [b]Broken Units:[/b] The "Monkey" unit is bugged on several maps and frequently fails to function. [*] [b]Reliability:[/b] Selecting a weapon (like the flamethrower) sometimes doesn't actually give it to you. Drones are also effectively useless. [*] [b]The Idle Trap:[/b] By round 100+, it becomes a "bad" idle game. [/list] [h1]Final Thoughts[/h1] [b]Who is this for?[/b] People looking for a very brief, cheap distraction, but don't expect a deep or polished experience. [b]Difficulty Note:[/b] There is no threat of losing. I beat the core game in 2 hours and cruised to round 60 on my second try. Even "hard" maps felt effortless, which makes it hard to stay engaged. [b]Conclusion:[/b] It’s a repetitive, buggy grind once the initial 7-hour charm wears off. I cannot recommend it in its current state.

Fun and addictive time waster

The game has about 30 minutes of extremely basic content. Early access was supposed to end more than a year ago, but the game appears never to have gotten past a basic framework that generally feels like an old flash game or maybe a cheap mobile game. Unfortunately I would not recommend buying this game at any price.

- only 4 maps - less than 10 hours gameplay, and most of that was afk. - gatelocked towers - balance is terrible (you get to a point where your towers are so op you can just go competely afk for hours - no difficulty settings - no basic tower defense things like tower damage/kill stats, target priority, speed increase, rush wave, etc only worth a couple of dollars.
Buggy, lacks balance, 4 maps = low replayability. Has potential.
It is not very polished, grindy, with no meaningful progression and with balance issues but still, it is a fun game, at an OK price.
Very solid towers defense for a EA! Music it's sick! Gameplay on the video:
Defender Bros is an exciting, fast-paced game with dynamic levels and engaging gameplay. The smooth controls and vibrant graphics make it a thrilling experience for gamers of all ages
[Speculative] Solo/online coop top-down tower defense game; you (during the day) explore/loot themed maps for scrap and (at night) defend your base from waves of foes using upgradable weapons/towers.
A cooperative and combat bagel with a top view. Survive, explore and build military bases - this is what you have to do in a harsh world full of insects. It will be difficult, but you will win.
Defender Bros fails at making its gameplay captivating past the first hour or two, leaving you with a repetitive mess that will hardly bring you any joy. It is not the TD game you're looking for!
A cooperative bagel with cool soldiers defending their military bases in different parts of the galaxy. A real combat strategy with tower defense elements! Destroy the giant insects and do your duty!
A good mix of tower defense and roguelike. Plus you have a fun dog companion.
